meta.name: logo-design-guide
meta.description: Logo design principles and AI image generation best practices for creating logos. Covers logo types, prompting techniques, scalability rules, and iteration workflows. Use for: brand identity, startup logos, app icons, favicons, logo concepts. Triggers: logo design, create logo, brand logo, logo generation, ai logo, logo maker, icon design, brand mark, logo concept, startup logo, app icon logo

copy.tagline: 用AI生成符合设计原则的品牌标志
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成专业且可缩放的品牌标志或应用图标。
copy.tagline_en: Generate brand logos that follow design principles using AI.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly create professional, scalable brand logos or app icons.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会指导你使用 AI 生成 Logo 图标，包括选择 Logo 类型、编写提示词、遵循可缩放规则和迭代优化流程。
howto.when: 当你提到“设计 Logo”、“创建品牌标志”、“生成应用图标”等关键词，或要求制作 Logo 时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个极简的几何山峰 Logo。
say.note: Claude 会生成一个符合要求的 Logo 图标。

say.text: 我想做一个科技公司的抽象 Logo。
say.note: Claude 会提供提示词示例并生成概念图。

say.text: 如何确保 Logo 在小尺寸下也清晰？
say.note: Claude 会解释可缩放规则并给出检查清单。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will guide you in using AI to generate logo icons, including selecting logo types, writing prompts, following scalability rules, and iterating workflows.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'logo design', 'create logo', 'brand logo', or ask to make a logo.

say_en.text: Design a minimalist geometric mountain peak logo.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a logo icon matching the request.

say_en.text: I want an abstract logo for a tech company.
say_en.note: Claude will provide prompt examples and generate concepts.

say_en.text: How to ensure the logo is clear at small sizes?
say_en.note: Claude will explain scalability rules and provide a checklist.
